documents.notes: Access URL is a legal-database mirror of the officially published treaty. The treaty entered into force 27 November 1991. It gives the Tumen mouth point as 42°17′34.34″ N, 130°41′49.16″ E and the territorial-sea endpoint as 42°09′ N, 130°53′ E, joined by a straight line.
